name: ON_GREEN_ARROW_WHITE_TALL
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. R9-SA107A (450 x 600) illustrated (B 600 x 800), R50, 8 / 24 (edge 8 + border 16). ON 90 D, GREEN 90 C, ARROW 90 C; chain 185/160/160/95 (baselines): tops 95, 255, 415. Widths ON 145 (152/145/153), GREEN 307 (71/307/72), ARROW 332 (59/332/59). Only with R2-15.
